questionText: Which compound word means a book containing maps?
explanation: Roadmap is a compound word - R-O-A-D-M-A-P. It means a plan or map showing routes.

questionText: Form a compound word: OVER + _____ = to defeat completely
explanation: Overwhelm means to defeat completely - O-V-E-R-W-H-E-L-M. It means to have an overpowering effect.

questionText: Which compound word means the state of being unable to see?
explanation: Colorblind is a compound - C-O-L-O-R-B-L-I-N-D. It means unable to distinguish certain colours.

questionText: Form a compound word: _____ + BREAK = a sudden start
explanation: Daybreak, outbreak, and groundbreak all work - B-R-E-A-K. Multiple compound words can be formed.

questionText: Which compound word means a written or printed work?
explanation: Paperwork is a compound - P-A-P-E-R-W-O-R-K. It means routine work involving documents.

questionText: Form a compound word: UNDER + _____ = to go below the surface
explanation: Underground means below the surface - U-N-D-E-R-G-R-O-U-N-D. It refers to below the earth's surface.

questionText: Which compound word describes a very clever person?
explanation: Mastermind is a compound - M-A-S-T-E-R-M-I-N-D. It means a person who plans and directs a scheme.

questionText: Form a compound word: SELF + _____ = caring for yourself
explanation: Self-care is a compound - S-E-L-F-C-A-R-E. It means taking actions to preserve your own health.

questionText: Which compound word means living things in a natural setting?
explanation: Wildlife is a compound - W-I-L-D-L-I-F-E. It means animals and plants in their natural environment.

questionText: Form a compound word: FIRE + _____ = a person who extinguishes fires
explanation: Firefighter is a compound - F-I-R-E-F-I-G-H-T-E-R. A firefighter puts out fires and rescues people.

questionText: Which compound word means a detailed plan?
explanation: Blueprint is a compound - B-L-U-E-P-R-I-N-T. It means a detailed plan or technical drawing.

questionText: Form a compound word: LIGHT + _____ = something very heavy cannot be described this way
explanation: Lightweight is a compound - L-I-G-H-T-W-E-I-G-H-T. It means not heavy or lacking in substance.

questionText: Which compound word describes the study of all subjects?
explanation: Coursework is a compound - C-O-U-R-S-E-W-O-R-K. It refers to work done as part of a course of study.

questionText: Form a compound word: BREAK + _____ = the first meal of the day
explanation: Breakfast is a compound - B-R-E-A-K-F-A-S-T. It means the morning meal that breaks the night fast.

questionText: Which compound word means an activity done regularly?
explanation: Workout is a compound - W-O-R-K-O-U-T. It means a session of physical exercise.

questionText: Form a compound word: _____ + SIDE = the edge of a road
explanation: Roadside is a compound - R-O-A-D-S-I-D-E. It means the area beside a road.

questionText: Which compound word means a warning signal?
explanation: Alarm bell is a compound - A-L-A-R-M B-E-L-L. It is a warning device that rings when triggered.

questionText: Form a compound word: OVER + _____ = to look at and supervise
explanation: Oversee means to supervise - O-V-E-R-S-E-E. It means to watch over and direct a process.

questionText: Which compound word describes someone who makes quick decisions?
explanation: Quick-witted is a compound - Q-U-I-C-K-W-I-T-T-E-D. It means mentally sharp and fast with responses.

questionText: Form a compound word: BOOK + _____ = where books are kept in order
explanation: Bookshelf, bookcase, and bookstore are all compounds - B-O-O-K. All are places related to storing books.

questionText: Which compound word means the start of something?
explanation: Kickstart is a compound - K-I-C-K-S-T-A-R-T. It means to give an impetus to start something.

questionText: Form a compound word: WATER + _____ = a marked boundary on a river
explanation: Watermark is a compound - W-A-T-E-R-M-A-R-K. It is a faint mark embedded in paper.

questionText: Which compound word means a person who helps others for free?
explanation: Volunteer is a compound origin word - V-O-L-U-N-T-E-E-R. It means a person who freely gives their time.

questionText: Form a compound word: BACK + _____ = a bag carried on the back
explanation: Backpack is a compound - B-A-C-K-P-A-C-K. It is a bag with straps worn on the back.

questionText: Which compound word describes information exchanged over the internet?
explanation: Broadband is a compound - B-R-O-A-D-B-A-N-D. It means high-capacity data transmission.

questionText: Form a compound word: HAND + _____ = something that works by hand
explanation: Handheld is a compound - H-A-N-D-H-E-L-D. It means a device that can be held in one hand.

questionText: Which compound word means a safe place from danger?
explanation: Safe haven is a compound - S-A-F-E H-A-V-E-N. It means a place of refuge and safety.

questionText: Form a compound word: OVER + _____ = to work more than required
explanation: Overtime, overwork, and overload are all compound words using OVER - O-V-E-R. All mean excessive effort.

questionText: Which compound word means a device that detects motion?
explanation: Motion sensor is a compound - M-O-T-I-O-N S-E-N-S-O-R. It detects movement in an area.

questionText: Form a compound word: SUN + _____ = the light from the sun
explanation: Sunshine is a compound - S-U-N-S-H-I-N-E. It means the direct light of the sun.

questionText: Which compound word means a type of plant used for medicine?
explanation: Peppermint is a compound - P-E-P-P-E-R-M-I-N-T. It is a type of aromatic plant used in medicine and cooking.

questionText: Form a compound word: FOOT + _____ = a note at the bottom of a page
explanation: Footnote is a compound - F-O-O-T-N-O-T-E. It is a note at the bottom of a page giving more information.

questionText: Which compound word means a situation requiring a quick decision?
explanation: Rush hour is a compound - R-U-S-H H-O-U-R. It means the time when traffic or activity is at its peak.

questionText: Form a compound word: LIFE + _____ = a jacket that keeps you afloat
explanation: Lifejacket is a compound - L-I-F-E-J-A-C-K-E-T. It is a safety device that keeps a person afloat in water.

questionText: Which compound word describes an official written record?
explanation: Logbook is a compound - L-O-G-B-O-O-K. It is an official record of events or activities.

questionText: Form a compound word: HARD + _____ = the physical components of a computer
explanation: Hardware is a compound - H-A-R-D-W-A-R-E. It refers to the physical parts of a computer system.

questionText: Which compound word means a strong opinion or belief?
explanation: Strong-willed is a compound - S-T-R-O-N-G-W-I-L-L-E-D. It means determined and not easily changed.

questionText: Form a compound word: OUT + _____ = to do better than
explanation: Outperform means to do better than - O-U-T-P-E-R-F-O-R-M. The prefix out- means beyond or more than.

questionText: Which compound word means a skill learned through practice?
explanation: Craftsmanship is a compound - C-R-A-F-T-S-M-A-N-S-H-I-P. It means skill in a particular craft.

questionText: Form a compound word: CROSS + _____ = an examination of a witness
explanation: Cross-examination is a compound - C-R-O-S-S E-X-A-M-I-N-A-T-I-O-N. It means questioning by the opposing party.

questionText: Which compound word means a list of tasks to be done?
explanation: Checklist is a compound - C-H-E-C-K-L-I-S-T. It is a list of items to be checked or done.

questionText: Form a compound word: MIND + _____ = paying close attention
explanation: Mindful means paying conscious attention - M-I-N-D-F-U-L. Mindfulness is the practice of being aware.

questionText: Which compound word describes an open area in a city?
explanation: Downtown is a compound - D-O-W-N-T-O-W-N. It refers to the central business area of a city.

questionText: Form a compound word: _____ + WORK = tasks done at home
explanation: Homework is a compound - H-O-M-E-W-O-R-K. It means tasks assigned to students to be done at home.

questionText: Which compound word means a person who manages others?
explanation: Middleman is a compound - M-I-D-D-L-E-M-A-N. It refers to a person who acts as an intermediary.

questionText: Form a compound word: WELL + _____ = the state of being comfortable
explanation: Well-being is a compound - W-E-L-L-B-E-I-N-G. It means the state of being healthy and happy.

questionText: Which compound word means something that covers the whole world?
explanation: Worldwide is a compound - W-O-R-L-D-W-I-D-E. It means extending or applicable throughout the world.

questionText: Form a compound word: SHORT + _____ = an error in judgment
explanation: Shortcoming is a compound - S-H-O-R-T-C-O-M-I-N-G. It means a fault or deficiency.

questionText: Which compound word means a person who tells stories?
explanation: Storyteller is a compound - S-T-O-R-Y-T-E-L-L-E-R. It means a person who narrates stories.

questionText: Form a compound word: LAND + _____ = an important piece of land or achievement
explanation: Landmark is a compound - L-A-N-D-M-A-R-K. It means an important or recognizable feature.
